protocol.initialization: Immediately before await plugins.enablePlugin(id), after awaited disable; finish after runtime registration and empty diagnostics; excludes host startup and unload.
protocol.readiness: Immediately before workspace.getLeaf(tab).setViewState; finish after Documents click, 100 exact fixture labels, aria-busy=false and two animation frames; includes mount, query, render and paint opportunity.
protocol.fixture: 100 stable-ID plugin-data item records, labels Reference item 001 through 100; schema 1; collection revision 100; each record revision 1.
protocol.policy: Three retained warmups then 30 sequential samples per metric; no retries, outlier removal or early readiness marker. Correctness failures abort and retain partial results.

serializerAttribution.definition: Rolldown renderedLength for tree-shaken YAML modules in this build graph. Not an additive allocation of final minified/compressed bytes or a counterfactual saving from removing YAML.

native bytes equal the retained release candidate and static artifact receipt

limits: Artifact integrity and matching-source validator execution are not signed proof of honest execution or release authorization.
Driver receipt times are not renderer throw times; renderer observation ends at CDP disconnect.
Controlled adapter save rejection inside a native host is distinct from a real native disk failure.

Independent fault/lifecycle ledgers are distinct from the bounded production diagnostic display; resources cover registered sinks, notification-policy timers, actions and pending availability, not global host resources.
A separately installed controlled witness plugin establishes foreign ownership in this isolated fixture, not compatibility with every third-party plugin.
Launch snapshots measure a shared runner before the public launch call; they establish neither an idle reference nor exact process-spawn resource conditions.
Historical Windows Appearance, Linux renderer illegal access, Windows coverage timeout and archive EBUSY causes remain unresolved by later passes.

Consumer/archive results have separately audited source identities and no consumer-native or archive-browser claim.
